projects.title: AYNYA
projects.subtitle: Voice-First Agentic Accessibility OS
projects.summary: An eyes-free AI operating layer designed for the visually impaired, enabling full device autonomy through a pure vocal interface and autonomous agent reasoning.
details: Voice-Driven UX: Engineered a seamless STT/TTS pipeline allowing users to navigate any app solely via natural language, eliminating the need for screen interaction.
Universal UI Interpretation: Leverages Accessibility Services to transform complex visual UI hierarchies into structured data for LLM processing.
Agentic Action Loops: A reasoning engine that plans and executes multi-step tasks (e.g., 'Order a taxi to my home') by navigating third-party apps autonomously.
Proactive Feedback System: Real-time vocal status updates and clarification cycles when the agent encounters ambiguous UI elements or requires user confirmation.

projects.title: AgriScan
projects.subtitle: Precision Agriculture & AI Ecosystem
projects.summary: A comprehensive mobile startup platform empowering farmers with AI-driven insights, automated crop diagnostics, and a direct supplier marketplace.
details: Multimodal AI Pipeline: Integrated OCR to process plant scans, feeding extracted data into a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture for precise disease diagnosis and treatment protocols.
Autonomous Weather Analysis: Real-time integration with weather APIs, using LLMs to correlate forecast data with specific farm metadata (soil type, crop stage) to deliver proactive risk alerts.
Agricultural Copilot: Context-aware chatbot for instant farming advice based on global best practices.
Integrated Marketplace: End-to-end shop connecting farmers directly with suppliers for seeds, fertilizers, and equipment.

projects.title: ValidAi
projects.subtitle: Smart Lab Management & Test Optimizer
projects.summary: A specialized LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) designed to streamline pharmaceutical product validation and optimize testing protocols through historical data analysis.
details: Intelligent Protocol Optimization: Developed a recommendation engine that suggests reductions in testing repetitions (e.g., from 3 to 2 reps) based on historical stability and performance, directly decreasing lab workload.
Regulatory Compliance Engine: Built-in validation logic strictly following ICH Q2 (Validation of Analytical Procedures) and ICH Q14 (Analytical Procedure Development) guidelines.
Talk-to-Data RAG: Integrated a conversational AI assistant allowing lab technicians to query product life cycles, test histories, and complex validation data using natural language.
Comprehensive Validation Tracking: Digital management of linearity and accuracy tests (multi-level/multi-repetition) with automated KPI dashboards and performance visualization.

projects.title: Al-Mizan
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Public Procurement Management Platform
projects.summary: A digital platform designed to modernize and streamline the entire public procurement lifecycle, from tender publication to bid evaluation and contract monitoring, enhanced with AI-assisted analysis and decision support.
details: End-to-End Procurement Digitalization: Covers the full lifecycle of public tenders including publication, supplier submissions, evaluation committees, and contract attribution.
Structured Workflow & Compliance: Implements strict multi-stage validation workflows to ensure transparency, traceability, and regulatory compliance in public procurement procedures.

AI-Assisted Analysis: Integrates AI tools capable of analyzing submitted bids, highlighting inconsistencies, extracting key information from documents, and assisting evaluators during decision-making.
Document & Audit Management: Centralizes procurement documents, bid files, and evaluation reports while maintaining a complete audit trail of all actions performed on the platform.

projects.title: Traçouf
projects.subtitle: Industrial Wool Traceability & Audit Ecosystem
projects.summary: A large-scale digitalization platform for the wool supply chain, featuring multi-platform synchronization, rigorous auditing stages, and AI-driven process monitoring.
details: End-to-End Traceability: Digitalized the entire lifecycle of wool from harvesting to final transformation, implementing mandatory audit checkpoints at each transition (Harvest, Depot, Washing, Processing).
Multi-Platform Architecture: Developed a synchronized ecosystem comprising a Kotlin mobile app for field harvesters, an operator web portal for facility management, and an advanced admin dashboard.
AI Audit Assistant: Integrated a chatbot capable of analyzing real-time supply chain data to provide operational insights and trigger automated alerts for process anomalies.
Cloud-Native Infrastructure: Built using a Microservices architecture and containerized with Docker to ensure high availability, scalability, and modular maintenance.

projects.title: Incop Email
projects.subtitle: High-Volume Email Marketing Engine
projects.summary: A professional-grade emailing platform designed for large-scale campaigns with real-time tracking and performance analytics.
details: Advanced Tracking System: Custom-built engine to monitor email opens, link clicks, and total response rates in real-time.
Campaign Management: Full lifecycle control from audience segmentation to automated scheduling and delivery.
Data-Driven Analytics: Comprehensive KPI dashboard providing actionable insights on campaign reach and conversion performance.
